data.name: Réponse_Pour_Questions_01_Fréquemment_Posées_Sur_CDE
data.value: The registration process and application review are done electronically without the need to travel to Entrepreneurship Development Centers (CDE).

data.name: Réponse_Pour_Questions_02_Fréquemment_Posées_Sur_CDE
data.value: Programs may include entrepreneurship sessions, project management, marketing, and others, and usually include practical training.

data.name: Réponse_Pour_Questions_03_Fréquemment_Posées_Sur_CDE
data.value: The student must graduate to register at Entrepreneurship Development Centers (CDE).

data.name: Réponse_Pour_Questions_04_Fréquemment_Posées_Sur_CDE
data.value: Registration at Entrepreneurship Development Centers (CDE) is possible regardless of the training institute where you studied. This depends on the center's policy and registration rules.

data.name: AccompagnementTitre1Text
data.value: The National Entrepreneurship Support and Development Agency accompanies you through every stage of your project, from the initial idea to the establishment of your enterprise. data.name: ActiviteNesda
data.value: Activities of the National Entrepreneurship Support and Development Agency

data.name: ActiviteNesdaText
data.value: The privileges of the NESDA’s mechanism cover the phases of setting up micro-enterprises and expanding their activity. The mechanism also includes various vital economic sectors to encourage entrepreneurship and investment in Algeria.

data.name: ActiviteP1Text
data.value: Support for the creation of micro-enterprises for young entrepreneurs includes financing, administrative and technical assistance, providing the necessary training and ensuring project follow-up from the beginning until the start of activity.

data.name: ActiviteP2Text
data.value: It aims to develop the current activity of micro-enterprises by adding new production lines, diversifying products, or launching complementary or independent new activities to expand the scope of work and increase revenues.

data.name: ActiviteTitre1P2
data.value: Not having previously benefited from any support mechanism to create a micro-enterprise.

data.name: ActiviteTitre1P3
data.value: having a certificate or professional qualification and/or recognized knowledge and skills certified.

data.name: ActiviteTitre1P4
data.value: Providing a personal financial contribution according to one of the selected financing.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P1
data.value: Registration via the digital platform after training at one of the Entrepreneurship Development Centers.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P2
data.value: The Agency’s services evaluate the project using a risk assessment system based on feasibility, efficiency, and financing criteria, and submit it to the Wilaya Committee if the evaluation exceeds 50%.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P3
data.value: The project holder presents the project to the committee for selecting, approving, and financing investment projects (CSVF) at the Wilaya.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P4
data.value: The Agency issues the eligibility and financing certificate upon committee approval and initiates administrative procedures with relevant departments and suppliers.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P4Titre
data.value: Issuance of Eligibility and Financing Certificate

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P5
data.value: The project begins after completing all procedures with the Agency.

data.name: ActiviteTitre2P6
data.value: In case of project rejection, an appeal can be filed with the Secretariat of the Committee within 15 days of notification. If rejected finally, the National Appeals Committee may be approached.

data.name: ActiviteTitre7Text
data.value: The Agency is committed to financing and promoting projects in various economic sectors, particularly those that contribute to generating wealth and creating jobs:

data.name: FinancementExploitationT1
data.value: Additional unremunerated Loan for renting premises

data.name: FinancementExploitationT1Text1
data.value: If necessary, project holders can benefit from an additional unremunerated loan to cover rent for renting premises or berths at ports designated for the creation of goods and services activities, excluding non-sedentary activities.

data.name: FinancementExploitationT1Text2
data.value: This loan is only granted when project holders apply for bank financing at the creation phase of the activity.

data.name: FinancementExploitationT2Text1
data.value: Project holders can exceptionally benefit from an additional unremunerated operating loan.

data.name: FinancementExploitationT2Text2
data.value: Exceptional to cover exploitation and operational needs

data.name: FinancementExploitationText
data.value: Additional unremunerated loans to cover specific needs:

data.name: FinancementTitre1
data.value: Financing takes you from an idea to project implementation

data.name: FinancementTitre1Text
data.value: The financing solutions offered by the agency have the following features:

data.name: FinancementTitre1TextP1
data.value: Unremunerated loan to finance the creation of micro-enterprises and the expansion of their activities

data.name: FinancementTitre1TextP2
data.value: Project funding can reach up to 10,000,000 DZD

data.name: FinancementTitre1TextP3
data.value: mixed and triangular joint financing formulas between the project owner, the Agency, and the bank

data.name: FinancementTitre1TextP6
data.value: Additional unremunerated loan for renting and operations

data.name: FinancementTitre2p1Text
data.value: The project owner finances the entire investment independently, without resorting to external sources.

data.name: FinancementTitre2p2Text
data.value: Both the project owner and the Agency each contribute 50% of the investment amount.

data.name: FinancementTitre2p3Text
data.value: The project holder contributes between 5% and 15%, the Agency contributes between 15% and 25%, and the bank covers the remaining 70%.

data.name: FinancementTitre2Text
data.value: The agency offers several financing options for creating and expanding micro-enterprises through 3 financial structures.

data.name: SolutionFinancementText
data.value: The National Entrepreneurship Support and Development Agency plays a pivotal role in financing micro-enterprises, by accompanying entrepreneurial idea holders who wish to transform their ideas into real projects that generate wealth and create jobs, in accordance with the adopted economic approach aimed at strengthening financing mechanisms and managing related risks, with the goal of driving national development.
